facts.anchor: “There you are!” Durian stumbles into my arm, taking part of my water with him.

facts.fact: 她在心里宣布与 Durian 的友情彻底结束。
facts.anchor: And it’s that thought that makes me realize my “friendship” with Durian is completely and entirely over.

facts.fact: 调酒师告诉她单已有人付了。
坐到她对面的人有一双死死盯着她脸的鼠尾草绿眼睛。
facts.anchor: They are sage green and hyper-focused on my face.
“I’m…” He hesitates, appears to mull over his intent. “Orzo.”

facts.fact: 她用「我还留着紫色青蛙」试探他。
「你去哪了？」这句问话她没来得及收回。
facts.anchor: “Where did you go?” The question leaves before I can take it back.
“Can you promise not to disappear again?”

facts.fact: 她把这次跌倒读成宇宙把她扔给了他。
facts.anchor: The universe has quite literally thrown me at him.
